name: Tondeke! Nayama Seed
original_name: とんでけ！なやましーど
source:
Magami High School Mystery Researchers is a school club commonly known as MMR. It focuses its activity on solving troubles. Adolescent girls are especially full of such troubles. Main character is not against taking advantage of these girls after success in each case.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
玛加米高中神秘研究员是一个通常被称为MMR的学校俱乐部。它的活动重点是解决问题。青春期的女孩尤其充满这样的烦恼。每次成功后，主角并不反对利用这些女孩。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
